rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no fixed retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body region carries no transition verb and no bare year; dated_line grep body_hits=0. A stale keep-note exists BELOW the cut at L134 and is reported as a todo, not a body finding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Timing location by surface.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 3:**Time:** 20 minutes. Single total, line 3, blank above and below, no phase breakdown, no slot context. Correct label, no retired variant.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 57:Anything can be inspected and reverse-engineered with an LLM. The stance note at L134 asserts the boundary 'lives in the third bullet'; grep for 'extraction quality' / 'quality of the tracker' returns only L134 itself.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy and project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 5:This capability unlocks transformational value across your entire delivery organisation. / 37:Unlike vendor tooling that locks your team in, this approach keeps you in control of the work. / 49:We believe the loop matters more than the model, and we built this training around that.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: L37 trips the hard sub-rule on 'vendor' plus the unlike-consultancy-decks shape; L5 and L49 import the positioning posture into a teaching beat. Cut all three from body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 11:Wire this through the subagent context window before you hit the compaction boundary.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: 'subagent' and 'compaction boundary' are ahead of arc position in an M1 exercise and never land in this file; 'context window' is legal AE101 working vocabulary, the other two are not.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pronoun/metaphor-referent check is NOT post-trim-gated, fires on ANY closer.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 11:Wire this through the subagent context window
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: 'this' has no antecedent, the sentence above it is the What-you-build widget line; and 'wire through' is a vague spatial metaphor standing in for an unnamed action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 33:propose five bug rules and 39:Push back on the five are counts of things the agent will produce, not a tally sitting above a visible list; no enumeration is adjacent. Closest to violating and stays inside.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing, run the truth test before reaching for 12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 24:Every test you write is a test the agent can never break.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Superlative 'never' asserted about how the world works, and the counterexample is one line away: this same training has the agent edit and rewrite tests, and a test can be deleted, skipped or made to assert nothing. No carve-out rescues it; cut the superlative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A sentence saying how you'd know points at the outcome, not the nearest artifact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 53:Does it sound like the comments already on the ticket? The test points at an artifact the student did not generate in this session, so it can come back negative. Not self-witnessing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No corrective-gap or tier-pegging phrasing in body; no 'at your scale' / 'for a beginner' shape. L5's overclaim is a register and positioning defect, filed under check_writing 13, not a gap assertion.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.

rules_evaluated.fix_hint: 'subagent' and 'compaction boundary' get no one-breath primer and never land operationally in this file; the assumed-known carve-out covers MCP/connector for the engineer audience, not these. Maintainer accept-note at L72 covers 'connector' only and is respected.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No narrating student's past or present state.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 20:Drop the ticket link after the colon. Sits squarely inside the action-in-the-moment carve-out (prompt-construction direction), and the prompt at L22 does end on 'Ticket:'. Closest to violating and stays inside.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body, THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 18:If there is no ticket for this bug, say so in the chat. The agent will offer to create one. Plausible failure plus a one-line non-obvious rescue, so the boundary keeps it in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.

rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Third axis: names no actor and no mechanism, and the student could not tell whether they had executed it. L53's register read is fine, it names the object (the comments on the ticket), the tell (wording feels off) and the addressee (tell Claude).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.

rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Four free-standing sentences, each dropped between a widget line and a prompt, none changing what the student does next; all four survive the deletion test cleanly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself, subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 49:We believe the loop matters more than the model, and we built this training around that. / 64:The next exercise sweeps this whole session.

findings.quote: We believe the loop matters more than the model, and we built this training around that.
findings.harm: The rule prevents student prose speaking as training-as-organisation, which turns a teaching beat into an institutional voice the student has no relationship with. Present here: the diagnostic substitution reads 'the training authors believe', and the sentence also carries the editorial flourish the rule warns rides along with the we.
findings.fix: Cut the sentence. Nothing downstream depends on it.

findings.quote: This capability unlocks transformational value across your entire delivery organisation.
findings.harm: The rule prevents marketing-deck framing landing where teaching should be, because engineers read the substance and decide for themselves. Present here: a benefit claim with no mechanism, sitting between the Time line and the What-you-do widget, at exactly the moment the student is trying to find out what they will do.
findings.fix: Delete. The What-you-do and The-point lines already carry the beat's promise in concrete terms.

findings.quote: Unlike vendor tooling that locks your team in, this approach keeps you in control of the work.
findings.harm: The rule prevents the project's own defensive-against-vendor posture being imported into a beat about reading tracker fields. Present here: the sentence defends the approach against a competitor nobody in the room raised, and the hard sub-rule makes 'vendor' suspect in body every time.
findings.fix: Delete. If a control point genuinely needs naming, name the concrete thing, not the contrast.

findings.quote: Every test you write is a test the agent can never break.
findings.harm: The rule prevents a slogan with no true reading shipping as memorable curriculum, because a professional audience finds the counterexample faster than the author does and then discounts the claims that are real. Present here: 'never' is asserted about how the world works, and this very training has the agent edit test files.
findings.fix: Cut the line. A carve-out cannot rescue it, and hedging it to 'usually' would be worse.

findings.rule: check_writing.md 14 + check_student_facing.md 2 (jargon ahead of arc, unearned term)
findings.quote: Wire this through the subagent context window before you hit the compaction boundary.
findings.harm: The rules prevent operational copy lifting vocabulary the student does not yet hold, which both stops the reader cold and pre-spoils the module that earns the term. Present here: 'subagent' and 'compaction boundary' are unearned at M1, never land in this file, and the sentence names no actor, no mechanism and no antecedent for 'this'.
findings.fix: Delete the line. If a real instruction is missing at this slot, write it in the words the student holds at M1.

todos.note: The 'Anything can be reverse-engineered' section has two bullets, no boundary paragraph. The stance note at L134 defends the bare slogan on the grounds that the caveat 'lives in the third bullet' (extraction quality tracking tracker-data quality). That bullet is not in the body. Either restore it or the 12 defence no longer holds.

todos.rule: check_writing.md 3 (keep-notes bind to their passage) - below the cut, reported as cross-check
todos.note: Same defect from the maintainer side: a keep-note asserting a passage that is not there. Out of body region so not filed as a body finding, but it is what makes the L57 gap invisible to the next judge.
'The next exercise sweeps this whole session.' Promises what a later beat will do. Present-tense state ('The field rules stay in the scrollback.') already carries the only thing the student needs.
